description: Runtime GPU detection on Windows: enumerate adapters via DXGI, identify vendor (NVIDIA/AMD/Intel), probe for encoder support (NVENC caps query, AMF factory init, QSV session query). Build a ranked encoder preference list: vendor-native HW encoder → cross-vendor HW → software fallback. Emit diagnostics showing detected GPU(s), chosen encoder, and capabilities (max resolution, B-frame support, 10-bit). Reuse Linux's existing detection for NVENC/VA-API.
title: Encoder auto-detection and GPU capability probing
